result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **I'd recommend Gusto**\. It offers the best overall balance of ease of use, payroll automation, tax filing, employee benefits, and HR features.

However, the best choice depends on how many employees you have, your budget, and whether you already use accounting software.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best payroll software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall)

# \$49/mo + \$6/person

- Automatic payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding and direct deposit
- Benefits and HR administration
- Easy-to-use interface

Best for businesses with 1–50 employees that want an easy, all-in-one solution.

**2\. OnPay**

(Best value)

# \$49/mo + \$6/person

- Full-service payroll tax filing
- Multi-state payroll
- W-2 and 1099 processing
- Benefits administration

Best for small businesses wanting straightforward pricing and strong payroll features.

[OnPay website](https://onpay.com/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

- Integrates with QuickBooks accounting
- Automated tax calculations and filing
- Direct deposit
- Payroll and bookkeeping reporting

Best if you already use QuickBooks for your business finances.

[QuickBooks Payroll website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payroll/)

---

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

(Best for growing businesses)

# Custom pricing

- Payroll automation
- Tax administration
- HR support and compliance tools
- Room to scale as you hire

Best for businesses that want a well-established provider and additional support.

[ADP RUN website](https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/run-powered-by-adp.aspx)
